<!--
The quickest way to report is the "Suggest a correction" button at the
bottom of the page: it opens this issue with the page address filled in.

A correction is fixed only against a primary source, so a link to the
vendor's own documentation, changelog or terms helps most. When the fix ships
it is logged on https://aifitnessapi.com/corrections.

Credit: if you want to be named on https://aifitnessapi.com/contributors,
write the name or GitHub handle to show after the colon on the credit line.
Leave it blank or write "no" to stay uncredited. Nothing else from this issue
is used for credit, and credit appears only once your report changes a page.
Everything in this issue is public.
-->
